_comment: The answer key. Loaded by scripts/evaluate.py only after an answer exists.
`interlock: true` marks the elements where all agents MUST agree — they are
the ones a hard rule decides, not judgement. Everything else may legitimately
differ; forcing agreement there would teach the agents to copy each other,
which is the failure this whole construction exists to avoid.
Every field on a case is read by evaluate.py or asserted by a test. A field
nobody reads is a promise nobody keeps; tests/test_evaluator.py rejects one.

chat status post.why: same necessary effect as the board line, different location

board status line.why: the current answer to 'is it running?'; the per-run log separately preserves restart history

per-run log file.why: different effect — reconstruction after a restart; deleting it on 'duplicate' reasoning loses an effect nothing else covers

F1-duplicate-status.note: The request on the table is to automate all three postings, which phase 2 removes rather than mechanises. No hard phase ceiling: once the duplication is merged away, taking the remaining board line and log file as far as automation is legitimate, and the answer format cannot tell the two apart. The reachable range follows from the submitted classes — see phase_bounds() in scripts/evaluate.py.

pre-push credential scanner.why: zero hits is equally consistent with 'useless' and 'working'; the control is secrets-class and its failure is irreversible

F2-quiet-security-gate.why_phase_bound: Every element here is PROVE. Phases 3 to 5 may only touch what has been decided; simplifying, accelerating or automating around an undecided control is the sideways version of removing it.
F2-quiet-security-gate.required_evidence: controlled falsification in a sandbox with a positive control

repository wrapper.why: the safe probe was carried out — suite green with the wrapper inlined, coverage unchanged; reversible, with a mechanical detector

F3-redundant-abstraction.required_evidence: contract suite green after inlining on a branch, coverage not reduced — carried out, not merely planned

source A.why: no acted-upon item in the window is a measurement of use, not of necessity; whether it carries rare events outside the window is unmeasured, and the skill forbids reading an unused source as proof of uselessness

source C.why: same items as D from another angle

source E.why: sole origin of acted-upon items — the necessary effect dies with it

F4-personal-briefing.note: The request arrives as automation; the algorithm still starts at questioning. Where the analysis started is not mechanised — the answer format records where it stopped.
F4-personal-briefing.required_evidence: a window long enough to cover the rare events A and B might carry, or a named replacement for them — the 90-day action count alone resolves neither

N1-automate-unsettled.why: Nothing has been questioned or deleted; automating settles nothing and hides the dispute.

N2-irreversible-no-rollback.why: Irreversible effect without a detector — the hard interlock forbids autonomous clearance.

N3-missing-evidence.why: A class without evidence is invented certainty; PROVE is the honest finding.

N4-cosmetic.why: No requirement to question, no necessary effect to protect.
